invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2250（基于ATR 19和-4.3%风险），或融资费率Z-score升至>50%（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $2133）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2250 (based on ATR 19 and -4.3% risk), or funding Z-score rises to >50% (short pressure eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $2133).
